input.content:
Thanks, Ava! I've verified your identity. 

Before we go further, I want to set expectations: unfortunately, I'm not able to remove just a single item from a pending order. What I can do with a pending order is one of the following:
1. Cancel the entire order (all items) with a refund, and you could place a new order for just the items you want.
2. Modify an item in the order to a different option of the same product (e.g., a different size or color of the fleece jacket).

Could you provide the order ID for the pending order with the fleece jacket (it starts with '#W')? Then I can check its status and we can go over the details of whichever option works best for you.
